Changelog

cellprograms 0.2.0

Stage B: frozen preprocessing and cell-level projection

  • freeze_preprocessing() (MR-0): resolve the feature panel and adjustment decisions once into a content-addressed specification (cell_program_preproc_spec, sha256 digest); refit any cohort carrying the same genes with fit_celltype_programs(preprocessing_spec = ...), which replays the spec fail-closed (conflicting explicit arguments are refused, and the spec’s digest is recorded in the fit’s preprocessing provenance).
  • project_programs_to_cells() (MR-1): project fitted programs onto individual cells. Query expression is adjusted with the fit’s recorded preprocessing (residualization coefficients, centering, scale), activities are inferred against the frozen gene loadings via flashier.utils::project_factor_activity(), and raw activities are canonicalized with the same RMS/sign multipliers as the donor scores. Requires a canonicalized fit with declared feature_scale; fits with residualized covariates require donors + sample_metadata, and the rebuilt covariate design must match the fit’s design columns exactly.
  • fit_celltype_programs() gains feature_scale (declared measurement units, recorded in the fit manifest and required for projection) and preprocessing_spec (MR-0 replay); fits now record a preproc_replay block per cell type so the exact adjustment can be replayed on query data.
  • New roadmap: reports/STAGE_B_ROADMAP.md (MR-0..MR-4 spec, staged main-run costs, registration drafts, gates).

Backend synchronization (Stage A)

  • Ordinary EBMF fits now delegate to flashier.utils::fit_ebmf() and canonicalization uses flashier.utils::standardize_factors(scaling = "rms"), with numerical parity verified to machine precision against the previous direct flashier::flash() backend. The public workflow, output fields, and scientific results are unchanged. flashier, ebnm, and flashier.utils move to Imports (R >= 4.3 required); the fixed-covariate path (covariate_mode = "fixed") and degenerate fits remain on the legacy backend. Set options(cellprograms.use_flashier_utils = FALSE) to force the legacy backend. See reports/SYNC_ROADMAP.md for the version pair, parity evidence, and rollback plan.

New features

  • find_coordinated_programs() and the CMP toolkit: coordinated multicellular program detection from donor-level program scores with within-strata permutation FWER control, plus cmp_scores(), ambient_program_scores(), annotate_cmp_lr(), annotate_cmp_themes(), cmp_gene_overlap(), cmp_context_association(), annotate_cmp_tf() (CollecTRI footprints via prepare_collectri()), cmp_triage(), and cmp_nuisance_genes().
  • program_sharing(): post-hoc shared-vs-specific assessment of matched programs across cell types with ‘mashr’ — permutation-calibrated loading matching, greedy agglomeration into disjoint matched groups, CorShrink-style null-correlation estimation (z_thresh configurable), and per-gene lfsr calls. Fits now store loading posterior SDs (F_psd/L_psd).
  • Artifact-gene masking: artifact_gene_sets (V(D)J, genotype-marker, sex sets), artifact_genes(), flag_artifact_genes(), and fit-time exclude_genes in fit_celltype_programs() (applied before variable-gene selection).

Bug fixes and robustness

  • program_sharing() handles degenerate real-data fits: numerically degenerate programs (noise-floor loadings; fixed factors with collapsed posterior SDs) are excluded from matching, and zero-SD point-laplace posteriors are floored relative to each condition’s loading scale instead of tripping mashr’s zero check.
  • simulate_pseudobulk() no longer fails with custom cell_types under the “mixed” and “same_genes_independent” scenarios (shared-program objects are created by the first present member instead of a hardcoded cell type).

Documentation and infrastructure

  • Full roxygen2 documentation: man/ pages for all exported functions with runnable examples; NAMESPACE is now roxygen-managed.
  • R-CMD-check CI (ubuntu + macOS) and a pkgdown site skeleton.
  • Quickstart vignette and a precomputed real-data case-study article.

Benchmarks

  • benchmarks/cmp_detection/: pre-registered v1.1/v1.2 confirmations of the frozen CMP caller (max_factors = 30 upstream; held-out seeds 1051-1100, all 7 criteria passed) and dev verdicts for four challenger arms (joint-subspace rejected; two-stage identical to winner; Cauchy closest miss; EB shrinkage no-op).
